# Artifact reference

<!-- Generated by `sst docs` from the engine's registries. Edit the registries, not this file. -->

SST publishes the artifact types below. `sst plan` orders changes by each
type's position, lowest first, and always places an artifact after the
artifacts it depends on. Types with a reference function can be named from
another artifact with `{{ <function>('<name>') }}`.

| Type | Position | Authored in | Publishes | Reference function |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [`semantic_view`](#semantic_view) | 100 | `semantic_views:` in `project.semantic_models_dir` | SEMANTIC VIEW | `semantic_view()` |
| [`tool`](#tool) | 200 | `project.tools_dir` | CORTEX SEARCH SERVICE, PROCEDURE, FUNCTION, or STAGE | `tool()` |
| [`skill`](#skill) | 250 | a `SKILL.md` folder in `project.skills_dir` | CORTEX EXTENSION (TYPE = 'SKILL') and its bundle stage | `skill()` |
| [`plugin`](#plugin) | 260 | `plugin.yml` in `project.plugins_dir` | CORTEX EXTENSION (TYPE = 'PLUGIN') and its bundle stage | `plugin()` |
| [`profile`](#profile) | 270 | `profile.yml` in `project.profiles_dir` | profile stage trees and one profile registry row | none |
| [`agent`](#agent) | 300 | `agent.yml` in `project.agents_dir` | AGENT | `agent()` |
| [`eval`](#eval) | 400 | an agent's `evals/` folder | TABLE, DATASET, and a staged run configuration | none |

## semantic_view

A Snowflake semantic view built from dbt models and the semantic members attached to them.

- Position: 100
- Lifecycle: one Snowflake object
- On update: replaced
- Grants: kept across a replace by `COPY GRANTS`
- `--prune`: drops it once its source is deleted
- Members: `relationship`, `fact`, `dimension`, `metric`, `filter`, `verified_query`, `custom_instruction`

## tool

A Snowflake object an agent tool calls, published before any agent that uses it.

- Position: 200
- Lifecycle: one Snowflake object
- On update: replaced
- Grants: re-applied after a replace
- `--prune`: never drops it
- Applied after: `semantic_view`

## skill

One `SKILL.md` folder, flattened and published as a Cortex Extension version whose alias is a hash of its content.

- Position: 250
- Lifecycle: composite -- several objects, reconciled together
- On update: altered or re-versioned in place
- Grants: never touched: the object is not replaced
- `--prune`: never drops it

## plugin

A named set of project skills, published together as one plugin-type Cortex Extension.

- Position: 260
- Lifecycle: composite -- several objects, reconciled together
- On update: altered or re-versioned in place
- Grants: never touched: the object is not replaced
- `--prune`: never drops it

## profile

A CoCo Desktop profile: content-addressed skill, prompt, MCP, and hook trees behind one profile registry row.

- Position: 270
- Lifecycle: composite -- several objects, reconciled together
- On update: altered or re-versioned in place
- Grants: never touched: the object is not replaced
- `--prune`: never drops it

## agent

A Cortex Agent whose specification SST renders and pins to exactly what it uses.

- Position: 300
- Lifecycle: one Snowflake object
- On update: altered or re-versioned in place
- Grants: never touched: the object is not replaced
- `--prune`: drops it once its source is deleted
- Applied after: `semantic_view`, `tool`, `skill`, `plugin`
- Pins the published version of: `skill`, `plugin` -- so a change to it plans only together with them

## eval

An agent evaluation: its question dataset, the table it reads, and its run configuration.

- Position: 400
- Lifecycle: composite -- several objects, reconciled together
- On update: altered or re-versioned in place
- Grants: never touched: the object is not replaced
- `--prune`: never drops it
- Applied after: `agent`

## Semantic view members

Members are authored separately and attach to semantic views; they are not
published on their own. Members read from dbt model metadata come from the
`config.meta.sst` block of each model's columns.

| Member | Owner | Authored as | Attaches by | Reference function |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `relationship` | `semantic_view` | `snowflake_relationships:` files | table membership | none |
| `fact` | `semantic_view` | dbt column metadata | table membership | none |
| `dimension` | `semantic_view` | dbt column metadata | table membership | none |
| `metric` | `semantic_view` | `snowflake_metrics:` files | table membership | `metric()` |
| `filter` | `semantic_view` | `snowflake_filters:` files | table membership | none |
| `verified_query` | `semantic_view` | `snowflake_verified_queries:` files | table membership | none |
| `custom_instruction` | `semantic_view` | `snowflake_custom_instructions:` files | view name | `custom_instructions()` |
